verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation rules are a fair question for a creative-generation platform with an API and agents, so the axis applies. The pack shows no documented rule engine, event triggers, or callbacks. Luma Skills ('Build a Creative Workflow Once, Run It Forever') and Luma Agents multi-step workflows describe reusable or multi-step workflows, not rules that fire automatically on events, so they earn no credit as an adjacent feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
